topic: How do on-board storage constraints influence payload power allocation between immediate and time-tagged service prioritization?
consensus_response: On-board storage constraints limit buffer size, introducing latency for time-tagged services. Efficient queue management and load distribution balance immediate and time-tagged traffic, ensuring timely execution while minimizing latency and waste. Adaptive coding and modulation schemes optimize power allocation, reducing latency and capacity waste.
reference_context: SatCom systems face trade-offs between fixed allocated capacity and dynamic allocation, with on-board storage constraints affecting buffer size and introducing latency.
